entities.name: Gev
entities.description: A lizardfolk mercenary from Goodhill on Bloomburrow wielding fire maces, member of Mabel's party.

entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: Burly mute badgerfolk, Gev's inseparable partner, named by Gev.

entities.name: Kiki
entities.description: Skunkfolk companion who may or may not be real.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Leader of the party that traveled to Pondside to investigate.

entities.name: Mabel's party
entities.description: Group assembled by Mabel to investigate in Pondside.

entities.name: Striped Rapscallions
entities.description: Name Gev, Hugs and Kiki used for themselves.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: Place Mabel ventured to in around 4564 AR.

events.summary: Gev stumbles on the nameless, mute badgerfolk Hugs on an adventure and they become fast friends.
events.quote: When he stumbled upon the badgerfolk Hugs on an adventure, they became fast friends

events.summary: Hugs fends off a Calamity Beast while Gev leads a town to safety; the children hug Hugs, and Gev names him.
events.quote: Hugs fended off a Calamity Beast , a moose , while Gev led a town to safety.

events.summary: Gev, Hugs and Kiki travel beyond the Outer Woods; the traumatic events lead Gev to invent tall tales.
events.quote: The events that took place were traumatic

events.summary: Gev begrudgingly joins Mabel's party to Pondside after Hugs volunteers.
events.quote: Gev begrudgingly decided to accompany her after Hugs also had volunteered

relations.quote: The two became inseparable, not only as mercenaries but as partners.
